name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his youth, fueled by the roaring engines of rally cars navigating the challenging terrains of Peru. He began his career as a junior mechanic, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for understanding the intricacies of vehicle dynamics. Ricardo's dedication and sharp analytical skills led to roles in data analysis and performance engineering, honing his ability to optimize car setups and driver strategies.

His move into team management was a natural progression, allowing him to blend his technical expertise with his innate leadership qualities. As Sporting Director, Ricardo thrives on creating a high-performance environment, fostering collaboration between engineers, drivers, and mechanics. He is known for his meticulous planning, data-driven decision-making, and unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of motorsport technology. Ricardo's distinctive approach lies in his ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop innovative solutions, ensuring his team is always one step ahead of the competition.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: Ricardo has a focused expression and a strong, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Obsessively cleans his glasses multiple times a day.
Insists on listening to a specific Peruvian folk song before every race.
